name: Nuvelo
positioning: Fictional running shoe maker. The Nuvelo Drift is a cushioned everyday running shoe. Used to study a single-hero sneaker launch page.
audience: Runners picking one soft shoe for daily miles.
voice: Numbers first: millimetres of foam, grams, sizes
Short plain lines, no hype words
Say what the foam does under the foot, not how it feels

direction.concept: Soft landing. The shoe floats above a pink cloud bank, so the foam story reads before a word does.
direction.tier: Single-hero sneaker page. Composition studied from a sneaker hero mock-up (white frame, sky, oversized shoe name behind the product, pink clouds below, dark pill action), used for layout only. No third-party marks, media, copy or code. The shoe is the Khronos Materials Variants Shoe (Shopify, CC BY 4.0) with its marks removed and recoloured; the clouds are drawn in code.
devices: The shoe name in oversized glass letters behind the shoe
A pink cloud bank that matches the foam
Scalloped cloud edges on the shoe's panels
invariants: Sky blue above, cloud pink below, white frame around
One shoe, floating toe down and heel up, credited in the footer
Every spec and price is fictional and the footer says so
variables: The shoe name in the glass letters

imagery.subject: One knit running shoe in candy pink with sky-blue laces and collar, floating above a bank of pink clouds in a blue sky
imagery.lighting: Bright daylight from above left, blue fill from the sky, pink bounce from the clouds below
imagery.palette: Sky #2f86d6 to #a9d4f2, cloud pink #f6b6d6, shoe pink #f7a3c8, lace blue #8fcbe8
invariants: The same shoe shape and colours everywhere
No logos or lettering on the shoe
Source and licence recorded in source-3d/PROVENANCE.md
avoid: Real shoe brand names, logos, swooshes or stripes
Models without a CC0, public-domain or CC BY licence

motion.character: The shoe bobs slowly and turns a little toward the pointer. The sky clouds drift sideways over a minute.
motion.reducedMotion: The shoe and clouds stay still. The play button starts the shoe's motion on request.

chapters.question: What is it?
chapters.message: Nuvelo Drift, a cushioned running shoe.
chapters.visual: The shoe floats toe up over pink clouds, its name in glass letters behind it.
chapters.mobileFallback: Name on top, shoe in the middle, action below.
